records.title: Bitcoin Genesis Block is mined
records.summary: Bitcoin's genesis block was timestamped 3 January 2009 and embedded the Times headline about a possible second bank bailout.
records.significance: The block began the Bitcoin blockchain and its embedded newspaper text became one of crypto's most iconic historical artifacts.

records.title: Bitcoin v0.1 software is publicly released
records.summary: Satoshi announced Bitcoin v0.1 and made the software and source code publicly available through SourceForge.
records.significance: The release turned Bitcoin from a paper into a runnable open-source monetary network.

sources.title: Bitcoin v0.1 released — Cryptography Mailing List

records.title: Hal Finney posts 'Running bitcoin'
records.summary: Hal Finney publicly posted the two-word message 'Running bitcoin' while operating the new software.
records.significance: It is one of the earliest surviving public signs of Bitcoin activity beyond Satoshi and became an iconic artifact of the network's birth.

sources.title: Running bitcoin — Hal Finney archival entry

records.title: Satoshi sends Hal Finney 10 BTC
records.summary: Bitcoin block 170 contains the first known person-to-person Bitcoin transaction: 10 BTC sent from Satoshi to Hal Finney.
records.significance: The transfer demonstrated Bitcoin working as a value-transfer network between two people.

records.title: New Liberty Standard publishes an early Bitcoin-dollar exchange rate
records.summary: New Liberty Standard published a rate of $1 = 1,309.03 BTC based on an estimate of the electricity cost of mining.
records.significance: It was an early effort to express Bitcoin in conventional currency before liquid exchange markets existed.

records.title: Martti Malmi completes an early documented BTC-for-fiat trade
records.summary: New Liberty Standard bought 5,050 BTC from Martti Malmi for $5.02 via PayPal.
records.significance: The transaction was an early step from theoretical Bitcoin valuation toward actual exchange for fiat money.
